528	class _SbomGraph:
529	    """Component identities and dependency edges declared by one SBOM document.
530	
531	    Both formats share these rules: every document reference maps to a
532	    component identity; several references may declare the same identity and
533	    then merge into a single catalog component; dependency edges are recorded
534	    between the merged identities, each identity pair only once, so reference
535	    names and document order never change the resulting catalog. Cycles
536	    between distinct identities are allowed, but an edge whose endpoints
537	    merge into the same identity is a self-dependency and rejects the import.
538	    """
539	
540	    def __init__(self) -> None:
541	        self.identities: dict[str, _Identity] = {}
542	        self.edges: set[_Edge] = set()
543	
544	    def ensure_unique(self, ref: str, duplicate_error: str) -> None:
545	        """References are unique within a document; duplicates are an error."""
546	        if ref in self.identities:
547	            raise ValueError(duplicate_error)
548	
549	    def register(self, ref: str, identity: _Identity) -> None:
550	        """Map a document reference to its component identity.
551	
552	        Mapping several references to the same identity is what merges them
553	        into one catalog component.
554	        """
555	        self.identities[ref] = identity
556	
557	    def identity_of(self, ref: str, unknown_error: str) -> _Identity:
558	        """Resolve a document reference to its merged component identity."""
559	        try:
560	            return self.identities[ref]
561	        except KeyError:
562	            raise ValueError(unknown_error) from None
563	
564	    def add_edge(
565	        self, dependent: _Identity, dependency: _Identity, refs: tuple[str, str]
566	    ) -> None:
567	        """Record a dependency between two merged identities, once.
568	
569	        ``refs`` are the document references the identities came from; they
570	        only serve to point out the offending edge when the endpoints merge
571	        into a single identity.
572	        """
573	        if dependent == dependency:
574	            raise ValueError(f"合并后产生自依赖: {refs[0]} -> {refs[1]}")
575	        self.edges.add((dependent, dependency))
576	
577	    def result(self) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
578	        return set(self.identities.values()), self.edges
579

599	def _parse_sbom(sbom: object) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
600	    """Validate an SBOM document and return (identities, edges).
601	
602	    Both CycloneDX 1.5 and SPDX 2.3 JSON are accepted; the format is
603	    recognized from the document itself. identities is the set of
604	    (ecosystem, name, version) tuples registered under the importing
605	    service. edges is a set of (dependent, dependency) identity pairs.
606	    All validation happens before any database write.
607	    """
608	    if not isinstance(sbom, dict):
609	        raise ValueError("清单必须是 JSON 对象")
610	    if "spdxVersion" in sbom:
611	        return _parse_spdx(sbom)
612	    return _parse_cyclonedx(sbom)

615	def _parse_cyclonedx(sbom: dict) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
616	    """Validate a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM and return (identities, edges)."""
617	    if sbom.get("bomFormat") != "CycloneDX":
618	        raise ValueError("bomFormat 必须为 CycloneDX")
619	    if sbom.get("specVersion") != "1.5":
620	        raise ValueError("specVersion 必须为 1.5")
621	    if "components" not in sbom:
622	        raise ValueError("缺少 components 字段")
623	    components = sbom["components"]
624	    if not isinstance(components, list):
625	        raise ValueError("components 必须为数组")
626	
627	    root_ref: str | None = None
628	    metadata = sbom.get("metadata")
629	    if isinstance(metadata, dict):
630	        root_component = metadata.get("component")
631	        if isinstance(root_component, dict) and "bom-ref" in root_component:
632	            root_ref = root_component["bom-ref"]
633	            if not isinstance(root_ref, str) or not root_ref:
634	                raise ValueError("metadata.component.bom-ref 必须为非空字符串")
635	
636	    graph = _SbomGraph()
637	    for index, component in enumerate(components):
638	        if not isinstance(component, dict):
639	            raise ValueError(f"components[{index}] 必须为对象")
640	        nested = component.get("components")
641	        if isinstance(nested, list) and nested:
642	            raise ValueError(f"components[{index}] 存在嵌套组件，不予登记")
643	        ref = component.get("bom-ref")
644	        if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
645	            raise ValueError(f"components[{index}] 的 bom-ref 必须为非空字符串")
646	        graph.ensure_unique(ref, f"bom-ref 重复: {ref}")
647	        if root_ref is not None and ref == root_ref:
648	            raise ValueError(f"bom-ref 与 metadata.component 根引用冲突: {ref}")
649	        context = f"components[{index}] (bom-ref {ref})"
650	        identity = _purl_identity(component.get("purl"), context)
651	        if "version" in component:
652	            _check_declared_version(
653	                component["version"], identity[2], f"{context} version"
654	            )
655	        graph.register(ref, identity)
656	
657	    dependencies = sbom.get("dependencies", [])
658	    if not isinstance(dependencies, list):
659	        raise ValueError("dependencies 必须为数组")
660	    for index, entry in enumerate(dependencies):
661	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
662	            raise ValueError(f"dependencies[{index}] 必须为对象")
663	        ref = entry.get("ref")
664	        if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
665	            raise ValueError(f"dependencies[{index}].ref 必须为非空字符串")
666	        depends_on = entry.get("dependsOn", [])
667	        if not isinstance(depends_on, list):
668	            raise ValueError(f"dependencies[{index}].dependsOn 必须为数组")
669	        if ref == root_ref:
670	            # The list root's own outgoing edges are not registered.
671	            continue
672	        dependent = graph.identity_of(
673	            ref, f"dependencies[{index}].ref 引用未知组件: {ref}"
674	        )
675	        for target in depends_on:
676	            if not isinstance(target, str) or not target:
677	                raise ValueError(
678	                    f"dependencies[{index}].dependsOn 必须为非空字符串数组"
679	                )
680	            if target == root_ref:
681	                raise ValueError(
682	                    f"dependencies[{index}] 组件 {ref} 依赖了 metadata.component 根引用"
683	                )
684	            dependency = graph.identity_of(
685	                target, f"dependencies[{index}] 依赖引用未知组件: {target}"
686	            )
687	            graph.add_edge(dependent, dependency, (ref, target))
688	
689	    return graph.result()

692	def _spdx_purl_identity(package: dict, index: int, ref: str) -> _Identity:
693	    """Extract a component identity from a package's purl external refs."""
694	    external_refs = package.get("externalRefs")
695	    if external_refs is None:
696	        raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) 缺少 purl 引用")
697	    if not isinstance(external_refs, list) or not external_refs:
698	        raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) externalRefs 必须为非空数组")
699	    identity: _Identity | None = None
700	    for ref_index, external_ref in enumerate(external_refs):
701	        if not isinstance(external_ref, dict):
702	            raise ValueError(
703	                f"packages[{index}].externalRefs[{ref_index}] 必须为对象"
704	            )
705	        if external_ref.get("referenceType") != "purl":
706	            continue
707	        candidate = _purl_identity(
708	            external_ref.get("referenceLocator"),
709	            f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref})",
710	        )
711	        if identity is None:
712	            identity = candidate
713	        elif candidate != identity:
714	            raise ValueError(
715	                f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) 多个 purl 指向不同组件身份"
716	            )
717	    if identity is None:
718	        raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) 缺少 purl 引用")
719	    return identity

722	def _parse_spdx(document: dict) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
723	    """Validate an SPDX 2.3 JSON document and return (identities, edges)."""
724	    if document.get("spdxVersion") != "SPDX-2.3":
725	        raise ValueError("spdxVersion 必须为 SPDX-2.3")
726	    document_spdxid = document.get("SPDXID")
727	    if not isinstance(document_spdxid, str) or not document_spdxid:
728	        raise ValueError("文档 SPDXID 必须为非空字符串")
729	    if "packages" not in document:
730	        raise ValueError("缺少 packages 字段")
731	    packages = document["packages"]
732	    if not isinstance(packages, list):
733	        raise ValueError("packages 必须为数组")
734	
735	    graph = _SbomGraph()
736	    for index, package in enumerate(packages):
737	        if not isinstance(package, dict):
738	            raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] 必须为对象")
739	        spdxid = package.get("SPDXID")
740	        if not isinstance(spdxid, str) or not spdxid:
741	            raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] SPDXID 必须为非空字符串")
742	        if spdxid == document_spdxid:
743	            raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] SPDXID 与文档标识冲突: {spdxid}")
744	        graph.ensure_unique(spdxid, f"SPDXID 重复: {spdxid}")
745	        identity = _spdx_purl_identity(package, index, spdxid)
746	        if "versionInfo" in package:
747	            _check_declared_version(
748	                package["versionInfo"],
749	                identity[2],
750	                f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {spdxid}) versionInfo",
751	            )
752	        graph.register(spdxid, identity)
753	
754	    relationships = document.get("relationships", [])
755	    if not isinstance(relationships, list):
756	        raise ValueError("relationships 必须为数组")
757	    for index, relationship in enumerate(relationships):
758	        if not isinstance(relationship, dict):
759	            raise ValueError(f"relationships[{index}] 必须为对象")
760	        relationship_type = relationship.get("relationshipType")
761	        if relationship_type == "DEPENDS_ON":
762	            source_key, target_key = "spdxElementId", "relatedSpdxElement"
763	        elif relationship_type == "DEPENDENCY_OF":
764	            source_key, target_key = "relatedSpdxElement", "spdxElementId"
765	        else:
766	            # DESCRIBES and every other non-dependency relation are ignored;
767	            # the document itself is never a component.
768	            continue
769	        source = relationship.get(source_key)
770	        target = relationship.get(target_key)
771	        if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
772	            raise ValueError(
773	                f"relationships[{index}].{source_key} 必须为非空字符串"
774	            )
775	        if not isinstance(target, str) or not target:
776	            raise ValueError(
777	                f"relationships[{index}].{target_key} 必须为非空字符串"
778	            )
779	        if source == document_spdxid or target == document_spdxid:
780	            raise ValueError(
781	                f"relationships[{index}] 引用了文档标识而非包: {source} -> {target}"
782	            )
783	        dependent = graph.identity_of(
784	            source, f"relationships[{index}] 引用未知标识: {source}"
785	        )
786	        dependency = graph.identity_of(
787	            target, f"relationships[{index}] 引用未知标识: {target}"
788	        )
789	        graph.add_edge(dependent, dependency, (source, target))
790	
791	    return graph.result()

794	class Catalog:
795	    def __init__(self, database: str | Path = ":memory:") -> None:
796	        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(str(database))
797	        self.connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
798	        # Let concurrent writers wait for each other; guarded UPDATEs still
799	        # ensure that two processes processing one request produce at most a
800	        # single state change.
801	        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000")
802	        self.connection.executescript(SCHEMA)
803	        self._migrate()
804	
805	    def _migrate(self) -> None:
806	        """Add ownership columns to databases created by earlier releases.
807	
808	        Components and relationships already present are considered manually
809	        registered, so they survive source replacement.
810	        """
811	        component_columns = {
812	            str(row["name"])
813	            for row in self.connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(components)")
814	        }
815	        if "manual" not in component_columns:
816	            self.connection.execute(
817	                "ALTER TABLE components ADD COLUMN manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
818	            )
819	            self.connection.execute("UPDATE components SET manual = 1")
820	        dependency_columns = {
821	            str(row["name"])
822	            for row in self.connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(dependencies)")
823	        }
824	        if "manual" not in dependency_columns:
825	            self.connection.execute(
826	                "ALTER TABLE dependencies ADD COLUMN manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
827	            )
828	            self.connection.execute("UPDATE dependencies SET manual = 1")
829	        self.connection.commit()
830	
831	    def close(self) -> None:
832	        self.connection.close()
833	
834	    @contextmanager
835	    def _write_tx(self):
836	        """A serialized write transaction.
837	
838	        ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` takes the database write lock up front, so two
839	        concurrent processes serialize their check-then-write sequences: the
840	        second blocks until the first commits and then observes its changes.
841	        Used for exemption requests and decisions to guarantee that a scope
842	        never gets two live requests and that a request changes state at most
843	        once.
844	        """
845	        self.connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
846	        try:
847	            yield
848	        except Exception:
849	            self.connection.rollback()
850	            raise
851	        else:
852	            self.connection.commit()

946	    def _delete_orphan_endpoints(self, candidate_ids) -> None:
947	        """Delete candidate components no registration or relationship keeps.
948

950	        some SBOM source still declares it, or it is an endpoint of another
951	        manually registered dependency. Each candidate is judged on its own,
952	        so deleting one relationship never removes a whole component group.
953	        """
954	        for component_id in candidate_ids:
955	            self.connection.execute(
956	                """
957	                DELETE FROM components
958	                WHERE id = ?
959	                  AND manual = 0
960	                  AND NOT EXISTS (
961	                      SELECT 1 FROM component_sources cs
962	                      WHERE cs.component_id = components.id
963	                  )
964	                  AND NOT EXISTS (
965	                      SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d
966	                      WHERE d.manual = 1
967	                        AND (d.dependent_id = components.id
968	                             OR d.dependency_id = components.id)
969	                  )

1026	    def import_sbom(
1027	        self, service: str, source_name: str, sbom: object
1028	    ) -> ImportResult:
1029	        """Register the components and dependencies of an SBOM document.
1030	
1031	        Both CycloneDX 1.5 and SPDX 2.3 JSON are accepted; the format is
1032	        detected automatically.
1033	
1034	        The source (service, source_name) is replaced: its previous components
1035	        and relationships lose ownership, and components/relationships no
1036	        longer owned by any source or manually registered are deleted. The
1037	        whole list is validated before any write, so failures leave the
1038	        catalog untouched.
1039	        """
1040	        service = service.strip()
1041	        source_name = source_name.strip()
1042	        if not service or not source_name:
1043	            raise ValueError("service 和 source 名称不能为空")
1044	        identities, edges = _parse_sbom(sbom)
1045	
1046	        with self.connection:
1047	            source_row = self.connection.execute(
1048	                "SELECT id FROM sources WHERE service = ? AND name = ?",
1049	                (service, source_name),
1050	            ).fetchone()
1051	            if source_row is None:
1052	                source_id = int(
1053	                    self.connection.execute(
1054	                        "INSERT INTO sources(service, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
1055	                        (service, source_name),
1056	                    ).lastrowid
1057	                )
1058	            else:
1059	                source_id = int(source_row["id"])
1060	
1061	            # Drop the previous ownership of this source.
1062	            self.connection.execute(
1063	                "DELETE FROM component_sources WHERE source_id = ?", (source_id,)
1064	            )
1065	            self.connection.execute(

1270	    def _direct_hits(
1271	        self, components: dict[int, dict[str, str]]
1272	    ) -> dict[tuple[str | None, str, str], dict[int, dict]]:
1273	        """Find the components directly hit by every vulnerability kind.
1274	
1275	        Returns a mapping from an impact-group key
1276	        ``(source, vulnerability id, matched package)`` — ``source`` is None
1277	        for a manually registered vulnerability and the source name for an
1278	        imported OSV record — to a mapping of directly hit component ids to
1279	        the hit description recorded at that terminal: ``severity``,
1280	        ``severity_basis`` and ``matched_conditions``.
1281	
1282	        Manual observations hit components by their verbatim package name and
1283	        carry no version conditions or severity basis. OSV records match on
1284	        the normalized PyPI package name and on the union of explicit
1285	        versions and ECOSYSTEM ranges compared with PEP 440; a candidate
1286	        component whose version cannot be parsed is a query error that
1287	        points out the component. Gathering both kinds here lets dependency
1288	        propagation, path selection and record generation share one code
1289	        path.
1290	        """
1291	        groups: dict[tuple[str | None, str, str], dict[int, dict]] = {}
1292	
1293	        for observation in self.connection.execute(
1294	            "SELECT id, component_name, severity FROM vulnerabilities"
1295	        ):
1296	            matched_name = str(observation["component_name"])
1297	            key = (None, str(observation["id"]), matched_name)
1298	            detail = {
1299	                "severity": str(observation["severity"]),
1300	                "severity_basis": None,
1301	                "matched_conditions": None,
1302	            }
1303	            terminals = groups.setdefault(key, {})
1304	            for component_id, component in components.items():
1305	                if component["name"] == matched_name:
1306	                    terminals[component_id] = detail
1307	
1308	        records = self._osv_records()
1309	        if records:
1310	            by_package: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
1311	            for record in records:
1312	                by_package.setdefault(record["package_name"], []).append(record)
1313	
1314	            for component_id, component in components.items():
1315	                if component["ecosystem"] != "pypi":
1316	                    continue
1317	                normalized = normalize_pypi_name(component["name"])
1318	                candidates = by_package.get(normalized)
1319	                if candidates is None:
1320	                    continue
1321	                try:
1322	                    version = Version(component["version"])
1323	                except InvalidVersion as error:
1324	                    raise ValueError(
1325	                        f"组件 {component['service']}/{component['ecosystem']}/"
1326	                        f"{component['name']}/{component['version']} 版本无法解析"
1327	                    ) from error
1328	                for record in candidates:
1329	                    matched_conditions = [
1330	                        _format_condition(condition)
1331	                        for condition in record["conditions"]
1332	                        if _condition_matches(condition, version)
1333	                    ]
1334	                    if matched_conditions:
1335	                        key = (record["source"], record["id"], normalized)
1336	                        groups.setdefault(key, {})[component_id] = {
1337	                            "severity": record["severity"],
1338	                            "severity_basis": (
1339	                                "default"
1340	                                if record["severity_default"]
1341	                                else "declared"
1342	                            ),
1343	                            "matched_conditions": matched_conditions,
1344	                        }
1345	        return groups

1370	    def _dependency_edges(
1371	        self, service: str | None = None
1372	    ) -> tuple[dict[int, list[int]], dict[int, list[int]]]:
1373	        forward: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
1374	        reverse: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
1375	        if service is None:
1376	            rows = self.connection.execute(
1377	                "SELECT dependent_id, dependency_id FROM dependencies"
1378	            )
1379	        else:
1380	            # Dependencies only ever connect components of the same service,
1381	            # so restricting both endpoints keeps a service-scoped graph closed.
1382	            rows = self.connection.execute(
1383	                """
1384	                SELECT d.dependent_id, d.dependency_id
1385	                FROM dependencies d
1386	                JOIN components c1 ON c1.id = d.dependent_id
1387	                JOIN components c2 ON c2.id = d.dependency_id
1388	                WHERE c1.service = ? AND c2.service = ?
1389	                """,
1390	                (service, service),
1391	            )
1392	        for row in rows:
1393	            dependent = int(row["dependent_id"])
1394	            dependency = int(row["dependency_id"])
1395	            forward.setdefault(dependent, []).append(dependency)
1396	            reverse.setdefault(dependency, []).append(dependent)
1397	        return forward, reverse

1399	    @staticmethod
1400	    def _component_identity_key(
1401	        component: dict[str, str]
1402	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
1403	        """Identity fields used as the deterministic path tie-breaker."""
1404	        return (
1405	            component["ecosystem"],

1410	    @staticmethod
1411	    def _reconstruct_path(
1412	        component_id: int,
1413	        distance: dict[int, int],
1414	        forward: dict[int, list[int]],
1415	        components: dict[int, dict[str, str]],
1416	    ) -> list[int]:
1417	        """Reconstruct the shortest path, ties broken by component identity."""
1418	        path_ids = [component_id]
1419	        while distance[path_ids[-1]] > 0:
1420	            current = path_ids[-1]
1421	            candidates = [
1422	                nxt
1423	                for nxt in forward.get(current, ())
1424	                if distance.get(nxt) == distance[current] - 1
1425	            ]
1426	            path_ids.append(
1427	                min(
1428	                    candidates,
1429	                    key=lambda nxt: Catalog._component_identity_key(
1430	                        components[nxt]
1431	                    ),
1432	                )
1433	            )
1434	        return path_ids

1436	    @staticmethod
1437	    def _propagate_distances(
1438	        terminals: dict[int, dict],
1439	        reverse: dict[int, list[int]],
1440	    ) -> dict[int, int]:
1441	        """Fewest dependency hops from each component to a directly hit one.
1442	
1443	        Multi-source BFS over the reverse dependency edges starting from all
1444	        directly hit components of one vulnerability/source/package group.
1445	        Cycles are handled by the distance map, so every component is
1446	        visited at most once and a path never repeats a component.
1447	        """
1448	        distance = {component_id: 0 for component_id in sorted(terminals)}
1449	        queue = deque(distance)
1450	        while queue:
1451	            node = queue.popleft()
1452	            for dependent in reverse.get(node, ()):
1453	                if dependent not in distance:
1454	                    distance[dependent] = distance[node] + 1
1455	                    queue.append(dependent)
1456	        return distance

1458	    def _impact_graph(
1459	        self,
1460	        service: str | None = None,
1461	    ) -> tuple[
1462	        dict[int, dict[str, str]],
1463	        dict[int, list[int]],
1464	        dict[int, list[int]],
1465	        dict[tuple[str | None, str, str], dict[int, dict]],
1466	    ]:
1467	        """Load the component/dependency graph and all direct vulnerability hits.
1468	
1469	        This is the single entry point shared by impact propagation, summary
1470	        counts and the risk report: manual observations and imported OSV
1471	        records are gathered into the same direct-hit groups, so a change to
1472	        propagation or path rules applies to every vulnerability source at
1473	        once.
1474	
1475	        When ``service`` is given, only that service's components and
1476	        same-service dependency edges are loaded. Components of other services
1477	        never reach OSV version matching then, so an unparseable version in an
1478	        unrelated service cannot fail a service-scoped query; a component the
1479	        selected service itself needs for matching is still a query error.
1480	        """
1481	        components = self._components_by_id(service)
1482	        forward, reverse = self._dependency_edges(service)
1483	        return components, forward, reverse, self._direct_hits(components)

1485	    @staticmethod
1486	    def _affected_ids_from_groups(
1487	        direct_groups: dict[tuple[str | None, str, str], dict[int, dict]],
1488	        reverse: dict[int, list[int]],
1489	    ) -> set[int]:
1490	        """Components directly hit or depending (transitively) on a hit one."""
1491	        affected: set[int] = set()
1492	        for terminals in direct_groups.values():
1493	            affected.update(terminals)
1494	        queue = deque(affected)
1495	        while queue:
1496	            node = queue.popleft()
1497	            for dependent in reverse.get(node, ()):
1498	                if dependent not in affected:
1499	                    affected.add(dependent)
1500	                    queue.append(dependent)
1501	        return affected

1503	    def _affected_ids(self) -> set[int]:
1504	        _, _, reverse, direct_groups = self._impact_graph()
1505	        return self._affected_ids_from_groups(direct_groups, reverse)

1507	    def summary(self) -> Summary:
1508	        _, _, reverse, direct_groups = self._impact_graph()
1509	        affected = self._affected_ids_from_groups(direct_groups, reverse)
1510	
1511	        # Manual observations and OSV hits share the direct-hit model; only
1512	        # groups with at least one directly hit component participate.
1513	        manual_severities: list[str] = []
1514	        osv_pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
1515	        osv_severities: list[str] = []
1516	        for (source, identifier, matched_name), terminals in direct_groups.items():
1517	            if not terminals:
1518	                continue
1519	            if source is None:
1520	                # One manual vulnerability row per group; its severity is the
1521	                # same at every directly hit component.
1522	                manual_severities.append(next(iter(terminals.values()))["severity"])
1523	            else:
1524	                # Imported vulnerabilities are deduplicated by id and
1525	                # normalized package name across sources, and only records
1526	                # that actually hit a component count.
1527	                osv_pairs.add((identifier, matched_name))
1528	                osv_severities.extend(
1529	                    detail["severity"] for detail in terminals.values()
1530	                )
1531	
1532	        row = self.connection.execute(
1533	            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS components FROM components"
1534	        ).fetchone()
1535	
1536	        highest: str | None = None
1537	        for severity in manual_severities + osv_severities:
1538	            if highest is None or SEVERITY_RANK[severity] > SEVERITY_RANK[highest]:
1539	                highest = severity
1540	
1541	        return Summary(
1542	            components=int(row["components"]),
1543	            affected_components=len(affected),
1544	            vulnerabilities=len(manual_severities) + len(osv_pairs),

1560	    def impact(
1561	        self,
1562	        service: str | None = None,
1563	        ecosystem: str | None = None,
1564	        name: str | None = None,
1565	        version: str | None = None,
1566	    ) -> list[dict]:
1567	        identity_filter = (ecosystem, name, version)
1568	        if any(value is not None for value in identity_filter):
1569	            if not all(value is not None for value in identity_filter):
1570	                raise ValueError(
1571	                    "ecosystem, name and version must be provided together"
1572	                )
1573	            if service is None:
1574	                raise ValueError(
1575	                    "service is required when filtering by component identity"
1576	                )
1577	
1578	        # Build the graph within the service scope up front, so components of
1579	        # other services never take part in OSV version matching or
1580	        # dependency propagation. A full component identity only narrows the
1581	        # final list; that component's own dependencies still participate, so
1582	        # transitive impacts on the target are never dropped.
1583	        records = self._impact_records(service)
1584	
1585	        if all(value is not None for value in identity_filter):
1586	            records = [
1587	                record
1588	                for record in records
1589	                if record["component"]["ecosystem"] == ecosystem
1590	                and record["component"]["name"] == name
1591	                and record["component"]["version"] == version
1592	            ]
1593	
1594	        records.sort(key=_impact_sort_key)

1597	    def _impact_records(self, service: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
1598	        """All current impact records, unfiltered and in an unspecified order.
1599	
1600	        One record per (component, vulnerability, source, matched package),
1601	        for both manual observations (``source`` None, no version conditions
1602	        and no severity basis) and named OSV sources (normalized PyPI package
1603	        match, terminal version conditions and a declared/default severity
1604	        basis). Every group goes through the same shortest-path propagation
1605	        and record construction, so propagation rules live in exactly one
1606	        place.
1607	
1608	        When ``service`` is given, matching and propagation run only over that
1609	        service's graph; components in other services never participate, so a
1610	        component with an unparseable version in another service cannot make
1611	        this service's query fail.
1612	        """
1613	        components, forward, reverse, direct_groups = self._impact_graph(service)
1614	        records: list[dict] = []
1615	
1616	        for (source, identifier, matched_name), terminals in direct_groups.items():
1617	            if not terminals:
1618	                continue
1619	            # Multi-source BFS over reverse edges: distance = fewest
1620	            # dependency hops from an affected component to a directly hit
1621	            # one. All directly hit components of the group are distance 0,
1622	            # so a component reached by several paths gets one record and
1623	            # propagation through cycles terminates at visited nodes.
1624	            distance = self._propagate_distances(terminals, reverse)
1625	
1626	            for component_id in sorted(distance):
1627	                hops = distance[component_id]
1628	                path_ids = self._reconstruct_path(
1629	                    component_id, distance, forward, components
1630	                )
1631	                # The hit details belong to the terminal component of the
1632	                # chosen shortest path; with several directly hit versions of
1633	                # the same normalized package this keeps each path's
1634	                # explanation tied to its own endpoint.
1635	                terminal_hit = terminals[path_ids[-1]]
1636	                records.append(
1637	                    {
1638	                        "component": dict(components[component_id]),
1639	                        "vulnerability": identifier,
1640	                        "source": source,
1641	                        "matched_name": matched_name,
1642	                        "severity": terminal_hit["severity"],
1643	                        "severity_basis": terminal_hit["severity_basis"],
1644	                        "direct": hops == 0,
1645	                        "matched_conditions": terminal_hit["matched_conditions"],
1646	                        "path": [dict(components[node]) for node in path_ids],
1647	                    }
1648	                )
1649

    def request_exemption(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        service: str,
        ecosystem: str,
        name: str,
        version: str,
        vulnerability: str,
        matched_name: str,
        source: str | None,
        applicant: str,
        reason: str,
        expires_at: str | datetime,
        *,
        submitted_at: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Apply to exempt one specific impact record.

        The scope is exactly (component identity, vulnerability id, matched
        package, source); ``source`` is None for a manually registered
        vulnerability and the source name for an imported OSV record. A retry
        with the same id and identical content confirms the original
        submission and returns the stored request exactly as it currently
        stands — its term, decision state and history are never altered, even
        when the retry happens at or after expiry, after the request was
        approved/rejected/revoked, or after the target impact disappeared. A
        reused id with any different content is rejected as a conflict. Only
        one live (pending or unexpired approved) request may exist per scope,
        and the expiry must be later than the submission instant only for a
        genuinely new request.
        """
        request_id = self._clean_text(request_id, "申请编号")
        service, ecosystem, name, version = self._clean_identity(
            service, ecosystem, name, version
        )
        vulnerability = self._clean_text(vulnerability, "漏洞编号")
        matched_name = self._clean_text(matched_name, "匹配包名")
        if source is not None:
            source = self._clean_text(source, "漏洞来源")
        applicant = self._clean_text(applicant, "申请人")
        reason = self._clean_text(reason, "申请理由")

        if submitted_at is None:
            submitted_at = utc_now()
        elif submitted_at.tzinfo is None:
            raise ValueError("提交时刻必须带有时区信息")
        else:
            submitted_at = submitted_at.astimezone(timezone.utc)

        if isinstance(expires_at, datetime):
            expiry = expires_at
            if expiry.tzinfo is None:
                raise ValueError("到期时间必须带有时区信息")
            expiry = expiry.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        else:
            expiry = parse_timestamp(expires_at, "到期时间")

        scope = (
            service, ecosystem, name, version,
            vulnerability, matched_name, source,
        )
        with self._write_tx():
            existing = self.connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM exemption_requests WHERE id = ?", (request_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                # An id names exactly one request for all time. Identical
                # content confirms the original submission and returns the
                # record exactly as it is now — no expiry check (the retry may
                # run at or after expiry), no impact-existence check (the
                # scope may have disappeared), no scope re-occupation, and no
                # change to the term, the approved severity or the history.
                # Any differing content is a conflict, never an overwrite.
                stored_scope = (
                    str(existing["service"]),
                    str(existing["ecosystem"]),
                    str(existing["name"]),
                    str(existing["version"]),
                    str(existing["vulnerability"]),
                    str(existing["matched_name"]),
                    None if existing["source"] is None else str(existing["source"]),
                )
                same_content = (
                    stored_scope == scope
                    and str(existing["applicant"]) == applicant
                    and str(existing["reason"]) == reason
                    and str(existing["expires_at"]) == format_timestamp(expiry)
                )
                if not same_content:
                    raise ValueError(f"申请编号 {request_id!r} 已用于不同内容的申请")
                return self._fetch_request(request_id)

            # Everything below applies only to a genuinely new request id.
            if expiry <= submitted_at:
                raise ValueError("到期时间必须晚于提交时刻")

            if not self._impact_exists(*scope):
                raise ValueError("申请目标不存在：当前没有匹配的漏洞影响记录")

            # No other live request may occupy the same scope.
            self._ensure_scope_open(scope, exclude_id=None, now=submitted_at)

            created = format_timestamp(submitted_at)
            self.connection.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO exemption_requests(
                    id, service, ecosystem, name, version,
                    vulnerability, matched_name, source,
                    created_at, applicant, reason, expires_at, status
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    request_id, *scope,
                    created, applicant, reason, format_timestamp(expiry),
                    EXEMPTION_PENDING,
                ),
            )
            self._append_event(
                request_id, submitted_at, applicant, "request", reason,
                None, EXEMPTION_PENDING,
            )
        return self._fetch_request(request_id)

    def _ensure_scope_open(
        self,
        scope: tuple,
        exclude_id: str | None,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> None:
        rows = self.connection.execute(
            """
            SELECT id, status, expires_at FROM exemption_requests
            WHERE service = ? AND ecosystem = ? AND name = ? AND version = ?
              AND vulnerability = ? AND matched_name = ?
              AND ((source IS NULL AND ? IS NULL) OR source = ?)
            """,
            (*scope[:6], scope[6], scope[6]),
        ).fetchall()
        now_text = format_timestamp(now)
        for row in rows:
            if str(row["id"]) == exclude_id:
                continue
            status = str(row["status"])
            if status not in EXEMPTION_OPEN:
                continue
            if str(row["expires_at"]) > now_text:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"同一范围已存在未到期的{_status_label(status)}申请: {row['id']}"
                )

    def _append_event(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        occurred_at: datetime,
        actor: str,
        action: str,
        reason: str,
        from_status: str | None,
        to_status: str,
    ) -> None:
        next_seq = self.connection.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM exemption_events WHERE request_id = ?",
            (request_id,),
        ).fetchone()[0]
        self.connection.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO exemption_events(
                request_id, seq, occurred_at, actor, action, reason,
                from_status, to_status
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                request_id, int(next_seq), format_timestamp(occurred_at),
                actor, action, reason, from_status, to_status,
            ),
        )

    def _fetch_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self.connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM exemption_requests WHERE id = ?", (request_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise ValueError(f"未知申请编号: {request_id}")
        return self._request_dict(row)

    def _request_dict(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
        events = [
            {
                "seq": int(event["seq"]),
                "at": str(event["occurred_at"]),
                "actor": str(event["actor"]),
                "action": str(event["action"]),
                "reason": str(event["reason"]),
                "from_status": (
                    None if event["from_status"] is None
                    else str(event["from_status"])
                ),
                "to_status": str(event["to_status"]),
            }
            for event in self.connection.execute(
                """
                SELECT seq, occurred_at, actor, action, reason, from_status,
                       to_status
                FROM exemption_events
                WHERE request_id = ?
                ORDER BY seq
                """,
                (str(row["id"]),),
            )
        ]
        return {
            "id": str(row["id"]),
            "scope": {
                "service": str(row["service"]),
                "ecosystem": str(row["ecosystem"]),
                "name": str(row["name"]),
                "version": str(row["version"]),
                "vulnerability": str(row["vulnerability"]),
                "matched_name": str(row["matched_name"]),
                "source": None if row["source"] is None else str(row["source"]),
            },
            "applicant": str(row["applicant"]),
            "reason": str(row["reason"]),
            "created_at": str(row["created_at"]),
            "expires_at": str(row["expires_at"]),
            "status": str(row["status"]),
            "decided_at": (
                None if row["decided_at"] is None else str(row["decided_at"])
            ),
            "approver": None if row["approver"] is None else str(row["approver"]),
            "decision_note": (
                None if row["decision_note"] is None
                else str(row["decision_note"])
            ),
            "approved_severity": (
                None if row["approved_severity"] is None
                else str(row["approved_severity"])
            ),
            "revoked_at": (
                None if row["revoked_at"] is None else str(row["revoked_at"])
            ),
            "revoker": None if row["revoker"] is None else str(row["revoker"]),
            "revoke_note": (
                None if row["revoke_note"] is None else str(row["revoke_note"])
            ),
            "events": events,
        }

    def get_exemption(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        """Return one request with its full processing history."""
        request_id = self._clean_text(request_id, "申请编号")
        return self._fetch_request(request_id)

    def list_exemptions(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
        """List requests (with history), newest first, id as tiebreaker."""
        query = (
            "SELECT * FROM exemption_requests "
            + ("WHERE status = ? " if status is not None else "")
            + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id ASC"
        )
        parameters: tuple = () if status is None else (status,)
        rows = self.connection.execute(query, parameters).fetchall()
        return [self._request_dict(row) for row in rows]

    def _process_decision(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        handler: str,
        note: str,
        action: str,
        target_status: str,
        when: datetime,
    ) -> dict:
        request_id = self._clean_text(request_id, "申请编号")
        handler = self._clean_text(handler, "处理人")
        note = self._clean_text(note, "处理说明")

        with self._write_tx():
            # Lock the row so two concurrent processes cannot both transition
            # it; the second transaction blocks here and then sees the new
            # status, so exactly one state change is accepted.
            row = self.connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM exemption_requests WHERE id = ?",
                (request_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError(f"未知申请编号: {request_id}")
            current_status = str(row["status"])
            if current_status != EXEMPTION_PENDING:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"只有待审批申请可以{_action_label(action)}，"
                    f"当前状态为{_status_label(current_status)}"
                )
            if format_timestamp(when) >= str(row["expires_at"]):
                raise ValueError("申请已到期，不能再审批")

            approved_severity = None
            if target_status == EXEMPTION_APPROVED:
                if handler == str(row["applicant"]):
                    raise ValueError("申请人不能批准自己的申请")
                scope = (
                    str(row["service"]), str(row["ecosystem"]),
                    str(row["name"]), str(row["version"]),
                    str(row["vulnerability"]), str(row["matched_name"]),
                    None if row["source"] is None else str(row["source"]),
                )
                current_severity = self._current_scope_severity(scope)
                if current_severity is None:
                    raise ValueError("审批时目标影响记录已不存在")
                approved_severity = current_severity
                cursor = self.connection.execute(
                    """
                    UPDATE exemption_requests
                    SET status = ?, decided_at = ?, approver = ?,
                        decision_note = ?, approved_severity = ?
                    WHERE id = ? AND status = ?
                    """,
                    (
                        target_status, format_timestamp(when), handler, note,
                        approved_severity, request_id, EXEMPTION_PENDING,
                    ),
                )
            else:
                cursor = self.connection.execute(
                    """
                    UPDATE exemption_requests
                    SET status = ?, decided_at = ?, approver = ?,
                        decision_note = ?
                    WHERE id = ? AND status = ?
                    """,
                    (
                        target_status, format_timestamp(when), handler, note,
                        request_id, EXEMPTION_PENDING,
                    ),
                )
            if cursor.rowcount == 0:
                raise ValueError("申请状态已被其他进程改变")
            self._append_event(
                request_id, when, handler, action, note,
                EXEMPTION_PENDING, target_status,
            )
        return self._fetch_request(request_id)

    def approve_exemption(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        handler: str,
        note: str,
        *,
        decided_at: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Approve a pending request, recording the severity then in force."""
        return self._process_decision(
            request_id, handler, note, "approve", EXEMPTION_APPROVED,
            decided_at or utc_now(),
        )

    def reject_exemption(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        handler: str,
        note: str,
        *,
        decided_at: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Reject a pending request."""
        return self._process_decision(
            request_id, handler, note, "reject", EXEMPTION_REJECTED,
            decided_at or utc_now(),
        )

    def revoke_exemption(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        handler: str,
        note: str,
        *,
        revoked_at: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Revoke an approved exemption that has not yet expired."""
        request_id = self._clean_text(request_id, "申请编号")
        handler = self._clean_text(handler, "处理人")
        note = self._clean_text(note, "处理说明")
        when = revoked_at or utc_now()
        if revoked_at is not None:
            if revoked_at.tzinfo is None:
                raise ValueError("撤销时刻必须带有时区信息")
            when = revoked_at.astimezone(timezone.utc)

        with self._write_tx():
            row = self.connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM exemption_requests WHERE id = ?",
                (request_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError(f"未知申请编号: {request_id}")
            status = str(row["status"])
            if status != EXEMPTION_APPROVED:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"只有已批准且未到期的申请可以撤销，"
                    f"当前状态为{_status_label(status)}"
                )
            if format_timestamp(when) >= str(row["expires_at"]):
                raise ValueError("豁免已到期，无需撤销")
            cursor = self.connection.execute(
                """
                UPDATE exemption_requests
                SET status = ?, revoked_at = ?, revoker = ?, revoke_note = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND status = ?
                """,
                (
                    EXEMPTION_REVOKED, format_timestamp(when), handler, note,
                    request_id, EXEMPTION_APPROVED,
                ),
            )
            if cursor.rowcount == 0:
                raise ValueError("申请状态已被其他进程改变")
            self._append_event(
                request_id, when, handler, "revoke", note,
                EXEMPTION_APPROVED, EXEMPTION_REVOKED,
            )
        return self._fetch_request(request_id)

    def _current_scope_severity(self, scope: tuple) -> str | None:
        """Severity of the live impact record exactly matching ``scope``.

        Re-confirmation is confined to the scope's own service, so a bad
        version newly added to another service cannot block an approval; a
        component within the service that still needs an OSV version
        comparison stays an error. Returns None only when the service graph
        builds cleanly but the target impact itself no longer exists.
        """
        for record in self._impact_records(scope[0]):
            component = record["component"]
            if (
                component["service"] == scope[0]
                and component["ecosystem"] == scope[1]
                and component["name"] == scope[2]
                and component["version"] == scope[3]
                and record["vulnerability"] == scope[4]
                and record["matched_name"] == scope[5]
                and record["source"] == scope[6]
            ):
                return str(record["severity"])
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _request_scope(row: sqlite3.Row) -> tuple:
        return (
            str(row["service"]), str(row["ecosystem"]),
            str(row["name"]), str(row["version"]),
            str(row["vulnerability"]), str(row["matched_name"]),
            None if row["source"] is None else str(row["source"]),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _inactive_link_reason(
        status: str, expires_at: str, at_text: str
    ) -> str:
        """Why the newest request of a scope is not currently in force.

        Approved-and-unexpired scopes never reach this function; their effect
        depends on the live severity and is decided while the report is built.
        """
        if status == EXEMPTION_PENDING:
            if expires_at <= at_text:
                return f"申请已于 {expires_at} 到期，未获审批"
            return "豁免申请尚在待审批"
        if status == EXEMPTION_REJECTED:
            return "豁免申请已被拒绝"
        if status == EXEMPTION_REVOKED:
            return "豁免已被撤销"
        # An approved request that is not in force can only have expired.
        return f"豁免已于 {expires_at} 到期"

    def _scope_exemption_links(
        self, moment: datetime, service: str | None = None
    ) -> tuple[dict[tuple, dict], dict[tuple, dict]]:
        """Load, in one read, both exemption views the report links against.

        The report used to first fetch every approved-unexpired request and
        then issue another scope lookup for each record without an active
        exemption, so the number of reads grew with the number of output
        records. Every relevant request is now read once here and grouped
        into the two maps the old precedence used:

        * ``active`` — an approved request whose term is in force at
          ``moment`` (the exemption still stops at the expiry instant). When
          several rows qualify for one scope — possible only at a past
          evaluation instant, since a later request cannot be submitted
          until the earlier term has lapsed — the last inserted row wins,
          matching the old unordered scan that overwrote per scope. Whether
          it covers the record is still decided against the current
          severity while the report is built.
        * ``latest`` — the newest request of the scope by the documented
          selection order (submission time newest first, id largest first on
          ties), used only when no approval is in force, together with the
          reason it is not currently covering the record.

        Directory and approval state are always taken at the current moment;
        ``moment`` only judges the term. Rows are confined to ``service``
        when the report is service-scoped; other services' scopes could not
        match the report anyway, but keeping them out also prevents their
        data from being read.
        """
        if service is None:
            rows = self.connection.execute(
                """
                SELECT rowid AS rid, id, service, ecosystem, name, version,
                       vulnerability, matched_name, source, status,
                       expires_at, approved_severity
                FROM exemption_requests
                ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                """
            )
        else:
            rows = self.connection.execute(
                """
                SELECT rowid AS rid, id, service, ecosystem, name, version,
                       vulnerability, matched_name, source, status,
                       expires_at, approved_severity
                FROM exemption_requests
                WHERE service = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                """,
                (service,),
            )
        at_text = format_timestamp(moment)
        latest: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
        active: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
        for row in rows:
            scope = self._request_scope(row)
            status = str(row["status"])
            expires_at = str(row["expires_at"])
            # Rows arrive newest first, so the first seen per scope is the
            # documented "latest request" selection; later rows are ignored.
            if scope not in latest:
                latest[scope] = {
                    "id": str(row["id"]),
                    "status": status,
                    "expires_at": expires_at,
                    "approved_severity": (
                        None
                        if row["approved_severity"] is None
                        else str(row["approved_severity"])
                    ),
                    "not_exempt_reason": (
                        None
                        if status == EXEMPTION_APPROVED and expires_at > at_text
                        else self._inactive_link_reason(
                            status, expires_at, at_text
                        )
                    ),
                }
            if status == EXEMPTION_APPROVED and expires_at > at_text:
                candidate = active.get(scope)
                # The old full-table scan saw rows in insertion order and the
                # last inserted approved-unexpired row survived; rowid keeps
                # that choice explicit and deterministic.
                if candidate is None or int(row["rid"]) > candidate["rid"]:
                    active[scope] = {
                        "rid": int(row["rid"]),
                        "id": str(row["id"]),
                        "approved_severity": str(row["approved_severity"]),
                    }
        return active, latest

    def risk_report(
        self,
        service: str | None = None,
        evaluated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Build the JSON risk report.

        Every current impact record is reported with its source, severity,
        direct/indirect flag and dependency path, plus exemption status: the
        linked request and, when an approved exemption is not in force for the
        record, the reason why. Counts and the highest severity consider only
        unexempted records.
        """
        if evaluated_at is None:
            moment = utc_now()
        elif isinstance(evaluated_at, datetime):
            if evaluated_at.tzinfo is None:
                raise ValueError("评估时刻必须带有时区信息")
            moment = evaluated_at.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        else:
            moment = parse_timestamp(evaluated_at, "评估时刻")

        scope_service: str | None = None
        if service is not None:
            scope_service = service.strip()
            if not scope_service:
                raise ValueError("service 不能为空")

        # Build impacts within the selected service only: same-name components,
        # dependencies and exemptions of other services never enter the report,
        # and an unparseable version elsewhere cannot fail this service.
        records = self._impact_records(scope_service)

        # Every exemption request is read once up front (scoped to the
        # selected service, exactly like the impact graph), so request data
        # is no longer queried once per output record.
        active, latest = self._scope_exemption_links(moment, scope_service)
        reported: list[dict] = []
        unexempted_components: set[tuple] = set()
        highest: str | None = None

        for record in records:
            component = record["component"]
            scope = (
                component["service"], component["ecosystem"],
                component["name"], component["version"],
                record["vulnerability"], record["matched_name"],
                record["source"],
            )
            entry = {
                "component": dict(component),
                "vulnerability": record["vulnerability"],
                "source": record["source"],
                "matched_name": record["matched_name"],
                "severity": record["severity"],
                "severity_basis": record["severity_basis"],
                "direct": record["direct"],
                "matched_conditions": record["matched_conditions"],
                "path": [dict(node) for node in record["path"]],
                "exempted": False,
                "exemption_request": None,
                "not_exempt_reason": None,
            }

            exemption = active.get(scope)
            if exemption is not None:
                current_severity = str(record["severity"])
                approved_rank = SEVERITY_RANK[exemption["approved_severity"]]
                if SEVERITY_RANK[current_severity] > approved_rank:
                    # The current rating exceeds what was approved: the
                    # exemption no longer covers this record, but the
                    # approval id stays linked instead of falling back to
                    # "no request".
                    entry["exemption_request"] = exemption["id"]
                    entry["not_exempt_reason"] = (
                        f"当前风险等级 {current_severity} 高于审批时的"
                        f"{exemption['approved_severity']}，超出审批范围"
                    )
                else:
                    entry["exempted"] = True
                    entry["exemption_request"] = exemption["id"]
            else:
                # No approval is in force for the scope: keep linking the
                # newest request (with its pending/rejected/revoked/expired
                # reason); an empty map entry still means no request exists.
                linked = latest.get(scope)
                if linked is not None:
                    entry["exemption_request"] = linked["id"]
                    entry["not_exempt_reason"] = linked["not_exempt_reason"]

            if not entry["exempted"]:
                unexempted_components.add(
                    (
                        component["service"], component["ecosystem"],
                        component["name"], component["version"],
                    )
                )
                if (
                    highest is None
                    or SEVERITY_RANK[record["severity"]] > SEVERITY_RANK[highest]
                ):
                    highest = str(record["severity"])

            reported.append(entry)

        reported.sort(key=_impact_sort_key)

        return {
            "evaluated_at": format_timestamp(moment),
            "service": scope_service,
            "impact_count": len(reported),
            "unhandled_component_count": len(unexempted_components),
            "highest_severity": highest,
            "impacts": reported,
        }


def _status_label(status: str) -> str:
    return {
        EXEMPTION_PENDING: "待审批",
        EXEMPTION_APPROVED: "已批准",
        EXEMPTION_REJECTED: "已拒绝",
        EXEMPTION_REVOKED: "已撤销",
    }.get(status, status)


def _action_label(action: str) -> str:
    return {
        "approve": "批准",
        "reject": "拒绝",
        "revoke": "撤销",
    }.get(action, action)
